newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Troubled Nigeria Airways sacks 250 staff.
newsitem.headline: Troubled Nigeria Airways sacks 250 staff.

text.p: Cash-strapped national carrier Nigeria Airways has laid off 250 workers in what an official spokesman said on Friday was rationalisation in the airline.
"This is a rationalisation exercise cutting across senior and junior cadres of staff," said spokesman Chris Aligbe.
Those sacked were anyone with a disciplinary record or whose productivity was considered to be waning, he said.
Once a strong airline flying to Europe, America and to other African nations, Nigeria Airways has shrunk to a fleet of only three aircraft although its staff strength is about 4,000.
Last year, the federal government ordered the laying off of more than a thousand workers from the airline and the airport authority in a purge of the aviation sector.
The heavily indebted Nigeria Airways has many other aircraft impounded by creditors around the world.

Since 1993 its lucrative New York route has been blocked by a U.S. ban on flights from Nigeria and an alliance with American airline World Airways to fly U.S. bound Nigerian passengers from Dakar, Senegal collapsed before it could take off.
